sketchBlocks.title: Gap separates Grid tracks

tryItExercises.title: Add consistent spacing between Grid tracks
tryItExercises.prompt:
## CSS task

The new Grid columns work, but neighboring items sit too close together. Grid `gap` creates consistent track spacing from the container instead of adding margins to individual items. Continue from the previous Grid checkpoint. Append `main { gap: 1rem; }`. Check the main layout: Grid items should have clear breathing room in both directions.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
tryItExercises.hint: Put the spacing on main so the Grid owns it.

help.concept: Grid `gap` creates consistent track spacing from the container instead of adding margins to individual items.
help.hint_1: Put the spacing on main so the Grid owns it.
help.hint_2: Check the main layout: Grid items should have clear breathing room in both directions.

sketchBlocks.title: repeat() expresses repeated tracks once

tryItExercises.title: Express the equal columns with repeat()
tryItExercises.prompt:
## CSS task

The two equal columns are correct, but writing the same track size twice does not express the repetition very clearly. repeat() captures that repeated track pattern without changing the visual result. Continue the cumulative stylesheet. Append `main { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }`. The preview should look the same after this refactor; the improvement is a clearer, more maintainable Grid definition.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
tryItExercises.hint: Refactor the repeated equal tracks rather than changing their size.

help.concept: repeat() captures that repeated track pattern without changing the visual result.
help.hint_1: Refactor the repeated equal tracks rather than changing their size.
help.hint_2: The preview should look the same after this refactor; the improvement is a clearer, more maintainable Grid definition.

sketchBlocks.title: Placement can span tracks

tryItExercises.title: Let the first main item span the Grid
tryItExercises.prompt:
## CSS task

The first main item has the same visual weight as every other Grid item even when it introduces the page. Grid line placement can make that first item span the full track range without adding a special wrapper. Continue the cumulative stylesheet. Add `main > :first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }`. Preview the layout: the first direct child of main should stretch across the Grid while later items keep their normal placement.

### File to edit

`styles.css`

### Check your work

Keep the site's existing cumulative work, make the requested change, then compare the **Preview** with the **Expected result** before moving on.
tryItExercises.hint: Use Grid lines from the first line through the last line on the existing first child.

help.concept: Grid line placement can make that first item span the full track range without adding a special wrapper.
help.hint_1: Use Grid lines from the first line through the last line on the existing first child.
help.hint_2: Preview the layout: the first direct child of main should stretch across the Grid while later items keep their normal placement.
